CLASS:  BBA/BCA/BAM   SEMESTER :II
BRANCH: BBA/BCA/BAM   SESSION: SP/2025

SUBJECT: MN111 DIGITAL EMPOWERMENT
TIME:  02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

   CO BL
Q.1(a) Describe digital empowerment with suitable example. [2] CO1 1
Q.1(b) Write short notes on "digital literacy is no longer a luxury but a necessity". [3] CO1 1


Q.2(a) Define the meaning and elements of digital inclusion and future inclusion. [2] CO1 1
Q.2(b) Explain the difference between digital empowerment and digital inclusion. [3] CO1 2


Q.3(a) List the main elements of digital inclusion. [2] CO2 1
Q.3(b) Discuss the different layers of cyberspace. [3] CO2 2


Q.4(a) Describe cyberspace with two examples. [2] CO2 1
Q.4(b) Explain 5 Ws of cyberspace. [3] CO2 2


Q.5(a) Explain the importance and benefits of cyber security in present context. [2] CO2 2
Q.5(b) Define the term cybercrime and list some common types of cybercrimes. [3] CO2 1
